tips.text: Run Circulus and skip Yuvarium; Normal Circulus pays as much Plasm as Steel Path Yuvarium with better drop rates.
Buy a piece with Plasm only if 50 Plasm stays left for the build.
Run it when Circulus has an Omnia Fissure; a full public squad means more Thrax and you crack relics too.
Regroup every 5 minutes so all the Thrax spawn together, and kill them for the extra Plasm.
Switch to your Operator and use Void Beam on a spectral Thrax; it cannot be hurt any other way.
Leave the mission if a Thrax stays stuck spectral; it never dies and drops nothing.
Leave after 15 minutes unless you also want Voruna; Rotation C has none of Sarofang.
Bring a crowd-clearing weapon like a Torid, Boar or Amprex, or a Necramech Summon, to clear Thrax.
Players like this farm because Plasm pays for any piece that will not drop, so bad luck only slows you down.
